answer: A bond is refunded only after 23 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The karst counter is kept in onyx and umber shows each reset. An attacker as a result has to keep each alias continuously active for 23 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 1174 identities would post 500 proofs and burn roughly 21 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
